description: This file defines the ArticlesController class, which handles HTTP endpoints related to articles, such as listing, retrieving details, creating, editing, and deleting articles in the application. It uses MediatR for request handling and ASP.NET Core attributes for routing and authorization.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller class managing article-related HTTP endpoints, utilizing dependency injection of IMediator, providing CRUD operations and article feeds.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET request for listing articles with optional filters, returns a task with ArticlesEnvelope.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET request for fetching article feed, with filters, returning a task with ArticlesEnvelope.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a specific article by slug, returning a Task<ArticleEnvelope>.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST request for creating a new article, requiring authorization, returns Task<ArticleEnvelope>.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT request for editing an article by slug, with authorization, returns Task<ArticleEnvelope>.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request for deleting an article by slug, with authorization, returns Task.
